runner_schedule.meaning: every minute: up to 60 units, each in its own transaction under the 8 s limit

owner_decision: 8 Oct 2026 (6, Penjalan): arah akhirnya berjalan di server, supaya tetap lanjut saat halaman ditutup. Membuka ulang harus melanjutkan job yang sama, bukan menghitung ulang atau menggandakan pekerjaan. 9 Oct 2026: K4 dikerjakan sekarang; audit nanti sekalian semua. runner.entry: pg_cron every minute: set statement_timeout to '8s'; then 60 x (begin; select cp7_ops.analysis_tick(); commit;) -> cp7_background.run_next()
runner.unit: Oldest progress across staged analysis, report v2, reminder condition sets and waiting single analysis. Exactly one existing step/run per tick, same actor, current access before/after; row SKIP LOCKED or existing nonblocking advisory lock. Busy families do not hold back another family.
runner.statement_limit: refused (55000 CP7_RUNNER_STATEMENT_LIMIT_REQUIRED) unless the session's statement_timeout is set and at most 8000 ms; PostgreSQL applies the command's 8 s to each statement; pg_cron's background-worker mode refuses the command's transaction statements, so no tick runs there; a unit stopped by the limit is an attempt, three in a row fail the job (CP7_ANALYSIS_STAGE_STOPPED), as for a page
runner.access: for every unit the job's stored actor is the transaction's request identity (sub, role authenticated) and cp7_schedule_native.access_now(false) is read before and after the unit; access different from the access at capture or denied fails the job (CP7_ANALYSIS_ACCESS_CHANGED); access changed during the unit discards the unit; the previous request identity is put back after the unit
runner.no_double_work: one job row lock per unit (a page step meanwhile answers worker_active and runs nothing), outputs primary key (job, unit); reopening with the same request UUID returns the same job and run
runner.status: job status carries server_runner {active: a tick in the last 2 minutes, last_tick_at}; the page then says the page may be closed and a stopped page does not pause the job
runner.private: cp7_ops.analysis_tick() SECURITY DEFINER as cp7_capture, EXECUTE for postgres only; run_next private; table cp7_analysis_stage.runner (one row, updated at most every 10 s, never deleted); no public RPC OW-02: cp7_background private dispatcher, no new public RPC or client grant; reminder table remains private, two reminder-owned capabilities expose only pending age and one guarded step.
runner.heartbeat: only the tick that takes the private lock hashtextextended('CP7:K4_RUNNER_HEARTBEAT',0) without waiting (pg_try_advisory_xact_lock) writes the runner row, first time or later; any other tick skips the heartbeat and goes on to its job (independent audit SOL-K4-01, Sol, 8cc1b081: the first row's insert made a second tick wait on a fresh installation)
runner.failure: Existing per-family failure/attempt rules; denied actor makes report/reminder/single job terminal FAILED after rolling back the unit, without storing output or claiming/sending reminders.
